checks.exercise: Limited-range Nordic curl with a 45-degree forward lean from the knees.
checks.equipment: Padded knee support and anchored ankle roller visible.
checks.setup: Front and side eight-frame sheets inspected; hips remain extended and trunk aligned.
checks.hands: Hands held forward ready for support; no hand push-off in this limited-range version.
checks.feet: Both knees and ankles fixed; feet extend behind the ankle restraint.
checks.movement: Controlled lean and return as one aligned trunk/thigh segment, continuous loop.

limitations: Limited 45-degree unassisted range; not full eccentric-to-floor or hand-assisted return.
Knee skin support gap up to 0.065 model units; ankle gap about 0.023; padded supports are rigid.
Sampled geometry is not complete mesh collision or biomechanics certification.
